screens.title: AI changes how risk work gets done.
screens.subtitle: The question is where it can improve the outcome, and what should remain under human control.
screens.closingLine: Start with the work. Then choose the technology.

screens.title: Pressure is rising on both sides.
screens.subtitle: Risk functions are being asked to respond faster, with stronger evidence and tighter economics.
screens.closingLine: The opportunity is not only faster work. It is a more evidence-led operating model.

screens.title: AI is a stack, not one tool.
screens.subtitle: Data and controls form the base. Autonomy increases only where the work allows it.
screens.closingLine: Higher in the stack does not mean better. It means a different trade-off.

screens.title: Start with the task, not the model.
screens.subtitle: Use the least complex pattern that can deliver the required outcome.
screens.closingLine: The task, evidence and decision right determine the technology.

screens.title: See one obligation move.
screens.subtitle: A source-backed example makes the flow of data, AI and human judgement tangible.
screens.closingLine: AI performs repeatable analysis. People retain judgement, challenge and approval.
screens.evidenceLabel: SOURCE-BACKED FLOW -- ILLUSTRATIVE TIMING -- NOT CLIENT DATA

screens.title: The use case changes the system.
screens.subtitle: Work, data, technology, governance and value typically move together.
screens.closingLine: A useful proof tests the process and the surrounding system, not only the model.

screens.title: Humans move toward judgement.
screens.subtitle: Repeatable execution may shift to automation, while accountability remains named and visible.
screens.closingLine: The key design question is what people should decide, challenge and own.
screens.evidenceLabel: ILLUSTRATIVE TASK MODEL -- NOT A HEADCOUNT FORECAST

screens.title: Prove one outcome on real work.
screens.subtitle: A proof should test quality, control, adoption, speed and economics together.
screens.closingLine: A working demo is not enough. The evidence should support a decision.

screens.title: Scale the pattern, not the pilot.
screens.subtitle: Shared data, orchestration, identity, evaluation and monitoring reduce repeated build effort.
screens.closingLine: The aim is reuse with control, not a new stack for every use case.

screens.title: Manage cost per successful case.
screens.subtitle: Run cost depends on the full path, not on model price alone.
screens.closingLine: Cost becomes manageable when it is measured at the outcome level.
screens.evidenceLabel: ILLUSTRATIVE COST PATH -- GENERIC UNITS -- NOT CLIENT DATA

screens.title: Use AI twice.
screens.subtitle: AI can reshape the client function and accelerate selected delivery activities.
screens.closingLine: Reusable assets, infrastructure knowledge and AI-assisted delivery can shorten the route to evidence.

screens.title: Begin with one evidence-led move.
screens.subtitle: Confirm the outcome, map one real process, and test one bounded path.
screens.closingLine: The first objective is not a platform. It is a decision supported by evidence.
